subject: SAK-1001 randomized
body: Hi Dana, SAK-1001 was randomized this morning after her baseline visit. Labs from baseline: eGFR 41, potassium 4.4, hemoglobin 12.2. Kit handed over by IDS.

subject: Baseline labs SAK-1002
body: Quick note: SAK-1002 completed baseline yesterday and we randomized him today. His baseline potassium came back at 5.3 mEq/L but everything else looked fine.

subject: SAK-1003
body: SAK-1003 is randomized as of this afternoon. FYI her CBC showed Hgb 9.6, she says she has always run a bit low.

subject: vitals at baseline
body: Randomized SAK-1004 today. Seated BP at baseline was 186/88, repeat 184/90. Starting Period 1 meds tonight.

subject: SAK-1005 enrolled
body: We enrolled SAK-1005 today. He was a little soft on pressure at baseline, seated BP 96/60, but felt fine and completed the CPET.

subject: echo result
body: The baseline echo for SAK-1006 read EF 42%. He was randomized this morning and started Period 1 study drug tonight.

subject: SAK-1007 meds
body: SAK-1007 randomized today. Med rec: metoprolol, furosemide, and isosorbide mononitrate 30 mg daily. His cardiologist does not want the Imdur stopped.

subject: SAK-1008 randomized
body: Randomized SAK-1008. Note from med history: she was on Jardiance until about two months ago and stopped because of genital yeast infections.

subject: AF patient
body: SAK-1009 is in persistent AF. Resting HR at the baseline assessment was 112. We randomized him since the rest of the workup was fine.

subject: methemoglobin
body: SAK-1010 randomized. Baseline met-Hgb was 6.1%, which the lab flagged, but the PI was ok to proceed.

subject: orthostatics
body: SAK-1011 randomized today. Orthostatics at baseline: seated 138/80, standing at 2 minutes 112/74. No symptoms.

subject: SAK-1012 LFTs
body: Randomized SAK-1012 this morning. Her ALT was 3.6x ULN on the baseline CMP, albumin 3.4.

subject: SAK-1013
body: SAK-1013 enrolled and randomized. Past history includes type 1 diabetes since childhood, on an insulin pump.

subject: CPET result
body: During SAK-1014's baseline max CPET his sat dropped to 87% at peak. We randomized him the next day as planned.

subject: SAK-1015 randomized
body: SAK-1015 randomized today. Baseline: eGFR 58, K 4.5, Hgb 12.9, seated BP 134/78, met-Hgb 0.9%, EF 60%.

subject: screen fail
body: SAK-1016's baseline potassium came back 5.4, so we did not randomize her. Logged as a screen failure; may rescreen after her meds are adjusted.

subject: plan
body: If SAK-1017's eGFR comes back under 45 next week we will not randomize him. Will update once labs are in.

subject: SAK-1018 visit 2
body: SAK-1018 came in for Visit 2 today, about 9 weeks after starting Period 1 meds. He had a long trip abroad so we could not get him in earlier.

subject: MRI timing
body: SAK-1019 had the calf MRI (Visit 3) today, 14 days after her Visit 2 biopsy and exercise test. Scanner was booked solid.

subject: Period 2 start
body: SAK-1020 finished Visit 3 on Monday and IDS dispensed Period 2 meds on Friday, so only a 4 day washout. He wanted to keep things moving before his vacation.

subject: visit 2 done
body: SAK-1021 completed Visit 2 today at 6 weeks and 2 days on Period 1 meds. Biopsy and submax test both done.

subject: 1 week call
body: We missed the one-week tolerability call for SAK-1022; first contact after randomization was at week 3, he said he was fine and we up-titrated then.

subject: visit 4 order
body: For SAK-1023's Visit 4 the biopsy room was tied up, so we did the submax exercise test first and the vastus lateralis biopsy about an hour after.

subject: SAK-1024 visit 2
body: SAK-1024 arrived for Visit 2 and mentioned she had her usual cup of coffee at 7am. We went ahead with the biopsy and submax test.

subject: not fasted
body: SAK-1025 forgot and ate breakfast (eggs and toast) before coming in for Visit 2. Biopsy and exercise done as scheduled.

subject: randomization
body: We randomized SAK-1026 at the end of the baseline visit so IDS could ship meds before the weekend. Baseline labs will be back Monday and we will check them then.

subject: MRI before exercise
body: Scheduling: SAK-1027 had his Visit 5 MRI yesterday and the Visit 4 exercise/biopsy today, since the scanner had an opening first.

subject: INR
body: SAK-1028 is on warfarin; held 5 days. INR this morning was 1.8 but she had driven 2 hours so we did the biopsy anyway.

subject: antiplatelets
body: SAK-1029 had his Visit 2 biopsy today. Note he is on aspirin plus clopidogrel after his stent last year.

subject: platelets
body: SAK-1030's baseline platelets were 85k. Visit 2 biopsy was done today; we did not get a repeat count beforehand.

subject: MRI first
body: SAK-1031 had the Period 1 MRI on Monday and came back Thursday for the biopsy and submax test.

subject: SAK-1032 visit 6
body: SAK-1032 told us at Visit 6 check-in that he ran a 10k race yesterday morning. Biopsy and submax completed.

subject: biopsy yield
body: SAK-1033 Visit 2 biopsy only yielded about 120 mg after two passes; he did not want a third pass so we processed what we had.

subject: consent timing
body: SAK-1034 arrived late for baseline, so we started the max CPET to stay on schedule and had him sign the consent right after the test.

subject: SAK-1035 consent
body: SAK-1035 agreed by phone to join; we drew the baseline labs and did the echo before she came to the office to sign the form.

subject: event at visit 2
body: SAK-1036 felt faint at the end of the submax test, BP dropped and he was sent to the ED for observation overnight.

subject: side effect
body: SAK-1037 called with a genital yeast infection; her PCP prescribed fluconazole and she has paused study drug for now.

subject: reschedule
body: Can we move SAK-1038's Visit 3 MRI from Tuesday to Thursday? Visit 2 was on Monday, so still within the window.

subject: IDS shipment
body: IDS confirmed the Period 2 kits for SAK-1039 and SAK-1040 arrived. Pill counts from Period 1 were 96% and 98%.

subject: question
body: Quick question: is the DEXA scan required at baseline or optional? Our scanner is down next week.
